learning_outcomes.text: Students will get knowledge about properties of fuels, combustion statics, types of combustion facilities and pollutants which are produced by combustion.

syllabus_topics: Fuel, types, fuel sources and theirs consumption
Characteristic of liquid and gaseous fuels
Energy value of fuel, high heating value, low heating value
Formation and reduction of NOX, SO2, CO, CO2 and solid particles
Combustion efficiency and efficiency of combustion facilities
bibliography: SMOOT, L., SMITH, P., Coal combustion and gasification, New York 1985, ISBN 0-306-41750-2
Edited by Loo and Jaap Koppejan, The Handbook of Biomass Combustion and Co-firing, UK 2008, ISBN 978-7-84407-249-1.
WILLIAMS A., POURKASHANIAN M.,JONES M., Combustion and gasification of coal, New Yeark 2000, ISBN 1-56032-549-6
PRABIR B., Combustion and gasification in fluidized beds, New Yeark 2006, ISBN 0-8493-3396-2
institution: Vysoka Skola Banska- Technicka Univerzita Ostrava
